http_binding.lifetime: one verified server request; ports and principal must not be shared across requests
http_binding.failure: null or any binding error -> RUNTIME_BINDING_INACTIVE; no legacy RPC or service_role fallback

operations.name: open_preflight_scope
operations.signature: (session, context_id, workspace_id, offering_id, published_revision_id) -> caller-owned serializable CoreTransactionScopeV1
requirements: same physical connection and transaction for scope reads
Workspace/service_request Offering aggregate lock before post-wait authority observations
current session check and authority revision bound to actor/context/workspace

operations.name: resolve_provider_agreement
requirements: exact Offering disclosure binding without calling S01 from its own witness
post-wait session, authority, disclosure, source and clock rechecks
SQLSTATE 40001 preserved unchanged to the trusted transaction caller

operations.name: execute_request
requirements: original command idempotency and exact replay
atomic request mutation, idempotency receipt, audit and outbox
unknown commit remains READBACK_REQUIRED and is never reported committed

principal.source: verified server session and canonical transaction authority only

operations.name: authenticate_http_request
operations.signature: (request: Request) -> verified current server session | null

operations.name: lease_role_scoped_connection
operations.signature: (verified session, context_id, workspace_id) -> owned physical pg connection lease
requirements: SET LOCAL request claims/context/workspace only inside transaction
identity and role assertion on checkout, BEGIN and settlement
poisoned/unknown connections quarantined instead of reused

operations.name: read_request_history
operations.signature: (current session, context_id, workspace_id) -> same committed service_catalog.requests row

connection: CONNECT to the owned isolated development database
explicitly_not_required: positive PUBLIC/anon/authenticated grants to app_private functions

implemented_guards: non-reservation and workspace-wide independent of BK01
inclusive start/exclusive end with PostgreSQL microsecond precision
fresh clock after final effective wait
no Order, Quote acceptance, fulfillment or payment
service.missing_input: one accepted request-local binding implementing both exact producer contract literals

connected_acceptance_after_delivery: browser -> V14 API -> Core host commit -> same Request readback
unknown result retry uses identical endpoint/body/key and produces no second effect

automation.automatable: source/toolchain checks and isolated connected acceptance after exact dependencies arrive
automation.value_criterion: durable same-request readback after restart with zero-write denial and exact-key unknown recovery
